attempts.summary: Configured a dedicated private link (eth1) between node1 (OpenWrt) and node2 (AlmaLinux), previously unconfigured, and applied tc traffic shaping on node1's eth1 (tbf egress + ingress police, both 1Mbit/s) so node2's traffic through node1 is capped to ~1Mbit/s in each direction, while node1's own traffic on its other interface (br-lan, e.g. to node3) remains unshaped at full speed (~120 Gbit/s). Verified with iperf3 measured transfers in both directions. Shaping is persisted via an OpenWrt hotplug script that reapplies tc rules on interface ifup, and survives node reboot. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured baseline boot_id/health on all 3 nodes, restarted them one at a time (node1, then node2, then node3), confirmed each node's boot_id changed after restart, and verified recovery of the private-link connectivity and the 1Mbit/s shaping after node1 and node2 restarted.
